title: CADMPEG 0.6.3 exact crate profile and semantic-probe refinement
mode: Primary-source web research and plan refinement; research only
scope: Resolve the earlier v0.6.3 crate documentation freshness gap
Separate the exact bare-stream profile from the separately distributed CLI release artifact
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 optional ACIS semantic-reader checkpoint without adding validation cadence

observed: Read-only bare SAT/SMT, ASM BinaryFile4/BinaryFile8, and ACIS BinaryFile 217/218 stream support is documented; container formats such as DWG/DXF are outside this crate's scope.
Supported records transfer through cadmpeg-asm into cadmpeg-ir; reports expose geometry_transferred and structured losses.
Other ACIS bands may use the 217/218 grammar under Admission::Unverified and a dialect-unverified loss; this must not be scored as verified semantic qualification.

Binary framing begins at the declared stream boundary/reference width and stops at the declared solved-record limit or terminator; documentation says it does not search arbitrary payload bytes for record signatures.
Crate documentation requires Rust 1.88+ and identifies Apache-2.0 licensing.
sources.limits: Documentation is not an executed result. It does not validate the exact local carrier profile, body semantics, source entity ownership, DWG AcDs association, or native CAD acceptance.

sources.revision: Source commit b504b8857432d3aa77e9539bfde1bb58d60ef93d, as recorded in the prior 2026-10-21 artifact-freshness receipt
sources.observed: The existing receipt pins the official CLI release and platform asset hashes. This research did not establish that a specific CLI archive embeds precisely the documented cadmpeg-codec-sat/cadmpeg-asm/cadmpeg-ir 0.6.3 dependency set.

The repository already has a bounded optional cq-acis observation harness and records CADMPEG and cq-acis as separate but limited parser/geometry routes. This update narrows the role of CADMPEG to one parser/neutral-topology cross-check and does not count crates, projects, documentation, or shared kernel lineage as extra independent votes.

assessment.documentationFreshnessGap: RESOLVED for cadmpeg-codec-sat 0.6.3 profile documentation only
assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing PAR-07/S8 optional gate only. Exact profile, source/dependency, carrier hash and owner binding, independent expected geometry, loss review, and any separate kernel/consumer stages remain required. No change to the local implementation order or per-slice fast-test policy.

selfUnblockingRule: If the exact artifact/dependency identity, platform, verified ACIS profile, complete geometry transfer, or attributable loss result cannot be established at the single optional checkpoint, record the exact missing stage as NOT_QUALIFIED and immediately continue the next local-ready implementation slice.
